scientific.integrity: The proof is exact and analytic. Its only non-elementary input is the published planar support-triangle formula for the translative convex-hull ratio; no numerical experiment or finite search is used as a substitute for proof.
limitations: Only nondegenerate centrally symmetric convex hexagons are classified.
The full minimum over nonsymmetric convex hexagons remains outside the claim.
No quantitative stability estimate is proved.
A residual originality risk is an unindexed elementary observation in the classical maximum-parallelogram or affine-polygon literature.

title: Sharp translative convex-hull ratio for centrally symmetric hexagons
